title: Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: An admin dashboard that turns module and web-app usage into clear statistics and graphs. See which experiences, spaces, days, and audiences perform best, in real time or after the event.
longDescription: A back-office analytics tool that aggregates usage data from BRDGE modules, web apps, and services into one place and renders it as clear charts and metrics. Operators can see which experiences draw the most engagement, which rooms or zones perform best, and how participation shifts by day, week, or season, so a museum, venue, or brand can spot trends, compare periods, and optimise layout, programming, and staffing. Configurable views let each client read the numbers that matter to them, in real time during an event or as a post-event report. BRDGE handles the data pipeline, aggregation, and visualisation, and connects to journey, leaderboard, and export outputs.

highlights.title: One View Across Everything
highlights.description: It pulls usage data from every module, web app, and connected service into a single admin dashboard, so scattered numbers become one clear picture of how the whole experience is performing.

highlights.title: See What Performs, Where and When
highlights.description: Break usage down by experience, room or zone, day, week, and season, so a museum or venue can see which spaces draw crowds, when the peaks and quiet spells fall, and how it all shifts over time.

highlights.title: Live Now, or the Full Story After
highlights.description: Watch usage update in real time while an event runs, then keep the very same dashboard as a post-event report. One tool covers the live moment and the follow-up.

highlights.title: Proof of Impact for the Pitch
highlights.description: It hands operators and resellers a concrete impact story: hard numbers on reach, engagement, and usage that back up decisions and make renewals and upsells easier to win.

highlights.title: Alerts, Reports & White-Label
highlights.description: Schedule automated reports, set threshold alerts that fire when a metric moves, add custom KPIs and chart types, or white-label the dashboard in the client's brand. New data sources and connectors slot in as paid upgrades.

highlights.title: Feeds On Every Module
highlights.description: It draws from any BRDGE module, web app, or service, so pair it with Live Feed to turn the same data into a participant-facing live screen, with Visitor Identificator to break usage down by visitor, or with Journey Manager to see how people move between spaces.
